using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Xunit;
using OpenRA.Server;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common.Server;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common.ServerTraits;
using OpenRA.Network;
using OpenRA.Support;
using S = OpenRA.Server.Server;
using NSubstitute;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests.ServerTraits
{
	public class MasterServerPingerTests
	{
		[Fact]
		public void UpdateMasterServer_SetsIsBusyToTrue()
		{
			// Arrange
			var server = Substitute.For<S>();
			var modData = Substitute.For<ModData>();
			var webServices = Substitute.For<WebServices>();
			webServices.ServerAdvertise.Returns("https://test-endpoint");
			modData.GetOrCreate<WebServices>().Returns(webServices);
			server.ModData.Returns(modData);

			var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();

			// Act
			pinger.UpdateMasterServer(server, "test-data");

			// Assert
			Assert.True(pinger.isBusy);
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task UpdateMasterServer_CallsHttpClientPostAsync()
		{
			// Arrange
			var server = Substitute.For<S>();
			var modData = Substitute.For<ModData>();
			var webServices = Substitute.For<WebServices>();
			webServices.ServerAdvertise.Returns("https://test-endpoint");
			modData.GetOrCreate<WebServices>().Returns(webServices);
			server.ModData.Returns(modData);

			var fakeClient = Substitute.For<HttpClient>();
			var fakeResponse = Substitute.For<HttpResponseMessage>();
			fakeResponse.Content.Returns(new StringContent("[]0]Success"));
			fakeClient.PostAsync(Arg.Any<string>(), Arg.Any<HttpContent>())
				.Returns(Task.FromResult(fakeResponse));

			// Replace HttpClientFactory.Create with our fake
			var originalCreate = HttpClientFactory.Create;
			HttpClientFactory.Create = () => fakeClient;

			try
			{
				var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();

				// Act
				pinger.UpdateMasterServer(server, "test-post-data");

				// Wait a bit for the Task.Run to complete
				await Task.Delay(100);

				// Assert
				await fakeClient.Received(1).PostAsync("https://test-endpoint", Arg.Any<HttpContent>());
			}
			finally
			{
				HttpClientFactory.Create = originalCreate;
			}
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task UpdateMasterServer_HandlesInitialPingResponse()
		{
			// Arrange
			var server = Substitute.For<S>();
			var modData = Substitute.For<ModData>();
			var webServices = Substitute.For<WebServices>();
			webServices.ServerAdvertise.Returns("https://test-endpoint");
			modData.GetOrCreate<WebServices>().Returns(webServices);
			server.ModData.Returns(modData);

			var fakeClient = Substitute.For<HttpClient>();
			var fakeResponse = Substitute.For<HttpResponseMessage>();
			fakeResponse.Content.Returns(new StringContent("[0]Success"));
			fakeClient.PostAsync(Arg.Any<string>(), Arg.Any<HttpContent>())
				.Returns(Task.FromResult(fakeResponse));

			var originalCreate = HttpClientFactory.Create;
			HttpClientFactory.Create = () => fakeClient;

			try
			{
				var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();

				// Act
				pinger.UpdateMasterServer(server, "test-data");

				// Wait for completion
				await Task.Delay(200);

				// Assert - isInitialPing should be false after first ping
				Assert.False(pinger.isInitialPing);
			}
			finally
			{
				HttpClientFactory.Create = originalCreate;
			}
		}

		[Fact]
		public void UpdateMasterServer_HandlesException()
		{
			// Arrange
			var server = Substitute.For<S>();
			var modData = Substitute.For<ModData>();
			var webServices = Substitute.For<WebServices>();
			webServices.ServerAdvertise.Returns("https://test-endpoint");
			modData.GetOrCreate<WebServices>().Returns(webServices);
			server.ModData.Returns(modData);

			var originalCreate = HttpClientFactory.Create;
			HttpClientFactory.Create = () => throw new HttpRequestException("Test exception");

			try
			{
				var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();

				// Act
				pinger.UpdateMasterServer(server, "test-data");

				// Assert - isBusy should eventually be reset
				Assert.True(pinger.isBusy); // Initially true
			}
			finally
			{
				HttpClientFactory.Create = originalCreate;
			}
		}
	}
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Xunit;
using Moq;
using OpenRA.Network;
using OpenRA.Server;
using OpenRA.Support;
using S = OpenRA.Server.Server;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests.ServerTraits
{
	public class MasterServerPingerTests
	{
		private static readonly FieldInfo IsBusyField = typeof(MasterServerPinger).GetField("isBusy", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)!;
		private static readonly FieldInfo IsInitialPingField = typeof(MasterServerPinger).GetField("isInitialPing", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)!;
		private static readonly FieldInfo MasterServerMessagesField = typeof(MasterServerPinger).GetField("masterServerMessages", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)!;

		[Fact]
		public void UpdateMasterServer_SetsIsBusyToTrue()
		{
			// Arrange
			var server = Mock.Of<S>();
			var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();

			// Act
			InvokeUpdateMasterServer(pinger, server, "test-data");

			// Assert
			Assert.True((bool)IsBusyField.GetValue(pinger));
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task UpdateMasterServer_CallsHttpClientPostAsync()
		{
			// Arrange
			var server = Mock.Of<S>();
			var mockClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			var mockResponse = new Mock<HttpResponseMessage>();
			mockResponse.Setup(r => r.Content).Returns(new StringContent("[0]Success"));
			mockClient.Setup(c => c.PostAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<HttpContent>()))
				.ReturnsAsync(mockResponse.Object);

			MockHttpClientFactory(mockClient.Object);

			try
			{
				var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();

				// Act
				InvokeUpdateMasterServer(pinger, server, "test-post-data");

				// Wait for background task
				await Task.Delay(500);

				// Assert
				mockClient.Verify(c => c.PostAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<HttpContent>()), Times.Once);
			}
			finally
			{
				RestoreHttpClientFactory();
			}
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task UpdateMasterServer_HandlesInitialPingResponse()
		{
			// Arrange
			var server = Mock.Of<S>();
			var mockClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			var mockResponse = new Mock<HttpResponseMessage>();
			mockResponse.Setup(r => r.Content).Returns(new StringContent("[0]Success"));
			mockClient.Setup(c => c.PostAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<HttpContent>()))
				.ReturnsAsync(mockResponse.Object);

			MockHttpClientFactory(mockClient.Object);

			try
			{
				var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();

				// Act
				InvokeUpdateMasterServer(pinger, server, "test-data");

				// Wait for completion
				await Task.Delay(500);

				// Assert
				Assert.False((bool)IsInitialPingField.GetValue(pinger));
			}
			finally
			{
				RestoreHttpClientFactory();
			}
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task UpdateMasterServer_HandlesHttpException()
		{
			// Arrange
			var server = Mock.Of<S>();
			var mockClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			mockClient.Setup(c => c.PostAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<HttpContent>()))
				.ThrowsAsync(new HttpRequestException("Test exception"));

			MockHttpClientFactory(mockClient.Object);

			try
			{
				var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();

				// Act
				InvokeUpdateMasterServer(pinger, server, "test-data");

				// Wait for task to complete and isBusy to reset
				await Task.Delay(500);

				// Assert
				Assert.False((bool)IsBusyField.GetValue(pinger));
			}
			finally
			{
				RestoreHttpClientFactory();
			}
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task UpdateMasterServer_ProcessesErrorResponse()
		{
			// Arrange
			var server = Mock.Of<S>();
			var mockClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			var mockResponse = new Mock<HttpResponseMessage>();
			mockResponse.Setup(r => r.Content).Returns(new StringContent("[1]No port forward"));
			mockClient.Setup(c => c.PostAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<HttpContent>()))
				.ReturnsAsync(mockResponse.Object);

			MockHttpClientFactory(mockClient.Object);

			try
			{
				var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();

				// Act
				InvokeUpdateMasterServer(pinger, server, "test-data");

				// Wait
				await Task.Delay(500);

				// Assert - messages were enqueued
				var messages = (System.Collections.Generic.Queue<string>)MasterServerMessagesField.GetValue(pinger)!;
				Assert.True(messages.Count > 0);
			}
			finally
			{
				RestoreHttpClientFactory();
			}
		}

		private static void InvokeUpdateMasterServer(MasterServerPinger pinger, S server, string postData)
		{
			var method = typeof(MasterServerPinger).GetMethod("UpdateMasterServer", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)!;
			method.Invoke(pinger, new object[] { server, postData });
		}

		private static Func<System.Net.Http.HttpClient>? _originalCreate;
		private static void MockHttpClientFactory(System.Net.Http.HttpClient fakeClient)
		{
			var type = Type.GetType("OpenRA.Mods.Common.ServerTraits.HttpClientFactory, OpenRA.Mods.Common")!;
			var createMethod = type!.GetMethod("Create", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static)!;
			_originalCreate = (Func<System.Net.Http.HttpClient>)Delegate.CreateDelegate(typeof(Func<System.Net.Http.HttpClient>), () => fakeClient)!;
			
			var field = type.GetField("_create", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static);
			if (field != null)
			{
				var original = field.GetValue(null);
				field.SetValue(null, _originalCreate);
			}
		}

		private static void RestoreHttpClientFactory()
		{
			if (_originalCreate == null) return;
			var type = Type.GetType("OpenRA.Mods.Common.ServerTraits.HttpClientFactory, OpenRA.Mods.Common")!;
			var field = type!.GetField("_create", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static);
			if (field != null)
				field.SetValue(null, _originalCreate);
		}
	}
}
